_comment: Page refresh registry for the VR.org maintenance audit. Each page lists its file path, refresh cadence in days, and a one-line refresh checklist. Run `npm run audit:pages` to see what is overdue.
policy: Best-of and pillar pages drive the majority of vr.org traffic. They must be refreshed on the cadence below. Real content edits required, not just dateModified bumps (Google's freshness signals discount unchanged content). Category hubs auto-fill from articles.json, but featured pins in data/featured.json, on-page descriptions, and CATEGORY_GUIDES links in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx all rot independently and get a monthly verification pass (they auto-populate, so a weekly manual cadence just produced false-overdue noise).
